knobs.name: DET_THRESHOLD
knobs.cell: c0 l.13; c1 guard; c2 l.43; c4 predict_cmd --det-threshold
knobs.what: Candidate-node threshold on the fused (dual-seed, TTA) detection map inside the predict subprocess: `arr = _detect_cells_pooled(det_logits[f_idx][0], t, cfg.det_threshold, pool_k)`; also the threshold of the retention guard counts. In the cell-1 drift guard (builder patches the guard for --set keys). Lower = more nodes into ILP/relink (runtime up, node-count risk).
knobs.tested_by_us: P04 exp19 0.95 -> 0.940 vs 0.941 (old public-0.941 pipeline, neutral). None on x138/K2. I-309/R13NC-4: not a profitable rung.
knobs.disclosed: imissher 743222 on the 0.947 stack: 0.960 -> 0.946, 0.970 -> 0.945 (unmodified 0.946/0.948; 'both directions lose, 0.965 at optimum'). amanatar V6 0.960 inside a 9-knob bundle (V6 public 0.901). indarkarhana retention-guard v1 0.96875 (July 0.913 fork). Every other public fork 0.965.

knobs.name: ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT
knobs.cell: c0 l.42; c2 l.49; c4 predict_cmd --ilp-division-weight (NOT in the cell-1 guard)
knobs.what: tracksdata ILPSolver division cost: `division_weight=cfg.ilp_division_weight` (c4 ILP patch). Lower = forks cheaper in the ILP. ILP forks never reach the output directly (motion relink is 1:1 and replaces ILP edges), so the effect is second-order: which nodes the ILP keeps (dummy: ~330 node swaps, +49 net) and orphan daughters feeding safe divisions (+3 safe forks 63 -> 66 on dummies).
knobs.tested_by_us: P03 exp18 0.9 -> 0.941 (old pipeline, neutral; later judged 'test invalid'). P50 exp85a = exp70g + 0.4 + READMIT 0.94 PENDING (submitted 05:02Z 28 Sep). Builds: exp85b (0.4 alone, dummy +0.04% nodes, 84 forks), exp86a/b/c, exp87a/b/i.
knobs.disclosed: John Taylor 743929 on his x138 fork: 1.2 -> 0.4 = +0.001 (0.957 -> 0.958), node change < 1%, 'local validators wrong 4/4'. indarkarhana v1 1.0 (July). 740573: ultrack zebrafish configs use division 0.001 / 0.1 (small, balanced); public lineage 1.2.

knobs.name: ILP_DISAPPEARANCE_WEIGHT
knobs.cell: c0 l.16; c1 guard; c2 l.48; c4 --ilp-disappearance-weight
knobs.what: ILP track-end cost: `disappearance_weight=cfg.ilp_disappearance_weight`. Higher keeps more nodes/longer tracks through the ILP (nodes not selected by the ILP are dropped before post-processing; readmit can bring some back).
knobs.disclosed: indarkarhana v1 1.5 (July 0.913 fork, also in its markdown); 740573 notes 'public lineage runs division 1.2 and disappearance 1.5' (older family). All x138 forks 2.

knobs.name: ILP_APPEARANCE_WEIGHT
knobs.cell: c0 l.15; c1 guard; c2 l.47; c4 --ilp-appearance-weight
knobs.what: ILP track-start cost: `appearance_weight=cfg.ilp_appearance_weight`; 0 = starts are free (asymmetric with disappearance 2).
knobs.disclosed: All public forks 0.0. 740573: ultrack configs appear 0.002 / 0.1 (balanced).

knobs.name: ILP_EDGE_WEIGHT
knobs.default: -1.0 (c2 default, not set in c0, not guarded)
knobs.what: `edge_weight=cfg.ilp_edge_weight * td.EdgeAttr("edge_prob")`: the reward per selected edge; scaling it is equivalent to inversely scaling all three event costs at once.

knobs.name: USE_ILP
knobs.what: Switch between the ILP and the repo's greedy linker. Structural, not a tuning knob.
knobs.disclosed: newwang12 v1-grouped derives it from an inference contract (same value).

knobs.name: ILP_TIMEOUT_S
knobs.what: `timeout=_ilp_timeout if _ilp_timeout > 0 else None` per dataset; SCIP returns its incumbent at the limit. Changes output only on clips that hit the limit; a safety knob, not a lever.

knobs.name: UNET_BATCH_SIZE
knobs.what: UNet inference batch; runtime/memory only (output identical up to GPU nondeterminism).

knobs.name: BIDIRECTIONAL_EDGE_WEIGHT
knobs.cell: c0 l.58; c1 guard; c4 guard `if not isclose(_bidirectional_weight_guard, 0.15): raise ValueError`; c4 harmonic patch
knobs.what: Reverse-time edge logits fused by a weighted harmonic mean of probabilities before candidate threshold/ILP. LOCKED: besides the cell-1 guard (which the builder patches) cell 4 raises ValueError unless it equals 0.15 -> a --set kernel errors.
knobs.disclosed: All public forks 0.15 (x138's own cell-1 print says 'Reverse-time association weight: 0.200', stale text; 0.15 is what runs).

knobs.name: BIDIRECTIONAL_FUSION_MODE
knobs.cell: c0 l.59; c1 guard; c13 print
knobs.what: Only read by the cell-1 guard and a cell-13 print; the harmonic code path in cell 4 does not branch on it. Dead (and a change trips the guard).

knobs.name: DUAL_SEED_MIN_CANDIDATE_RETENTION
knobs.cell: c0 l.60; c1 guard; HARD-SET c4 l.85
knobs.what: Frame retention guard: falls back to primary-only detection in a frame when the blended map keeps < 90% of the primary's candidates. Cell 4 re-sets it to '0.90' after cell 0 -> --set is a silent no-op.
knobs.disclosed: amanatar V6 0.75 (made settable in its own cell 4).

knobs.name: DUAL_SEED_EDGE_THRESHOLD
knobs.cell: HARD-SET c3 l.663; read in c4 predict patch
knobs.what: Candidate-edge probability threshold for the ILP graph (`os.environ.get("BIOHUB_DUAL_SEED_EDGE_THRESHOLD", str(cfg.threshold))`). Hard-set in cell 3 after cell 0 -> --set no-op.

knobs.name: SECONDARY_DETECTION_WEIGHT
knobs.what: Blend weight of the seed314159 secondary detector logits. Hard-set -> --set no-op.

knobs.name: SECONDARY_EDGE_WEIGHT
knobs.what: Secondary-model edge-logit mixing weight. Hard-set -> no-op.
knobs.tested_by_us: Secondary swaps P07/P10/P13 (weights, not this knob) all negative.

knobs.name: SECONDARY_LINK_MODE / SECONDARY_MIX_TEMPERATURE / SECONDARY_LOW_MARGIN_MAX
knobs.what: How secondary edge logits are mixed (only on low-margin primary rows). Hard-set -> no-op.
knobs.disclosed: anhadmahajan track-your-cells: LINK_MODE adaptive; everyone else low_margin_consensus / 1 / 0.35.

knobs.name: EDGE_FEATURE_TTA / SECONDARY_EDGE_FEATURE_TTA / SECONDARY_EDGE_FEATURE_TTA_WEIGHT
knobs.what: Edge-feature flip TTA for primary and secondary encoders. Hard-set after cell 0 -> no-op.
knobs.disclosed: sjlee/mtoshidesu dctta020-sectta1: TTA weight 1.0 -> 0.947 (tie on the 0.947 stack).

knobs.name: SECONDARY_WEIGHTS / SECONDARY_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST
knobs.what: Which secondary checkpoint is loaded (sha-checked in cell 3). Only changeable with our secswap patch, not --set.
knobs.tested_by_us: exp79d/exp81 secft/n2a secondaries built (N2 files); P07/P10/P13 secondary swaps negative on old stacks.

knobs.name: LOWDET_THRESHOLD
knobs.what: `_low = _detect_cells_pooled(det_logits[f_idx][0], t, _LOWDET_THRESHOLD, pool_k)` dumps sub-threshold peaks to CACHE_DIR for gapfill/readmit. The post-proc pool then drops `score < GAPFILL_MIN_SCORE` (0.5), so any value in [0, 0.5] is output-inert (only dump size); > 0.5 shrinks the gapfill pool.

knobs.name: LOWREFINE_ENABLE
knobs.what: Runs the V1284 coordinate head on lowdet peaks with score >= READMIT_MIN_SCORE (`_lhi = _lsc >= _LOWREFINE_MIN_SCORE`) so readmitted/gapfilled nodes get refined, float coordinates.
knobs.tested_by_us: Part of K2: P38 exp58n (x138 + safetail + lowrefine) 0.953 = x138 0.953 (tie); in every K2 probe since.

knobs.name: CACHE_DIR
knobs.cell: c0 l.104; c4 dump patch; c7 l.1216
knobs.what: Where the lowdet dump is written/read. Unset -> `load_low_detections` returns None -> gapfill AND readmit idle. Infra, not a lever.

knobs.name: CACHE_EDGE_THRESHOLD
knobs.what: `if _CACHE_THRESHOLD > 0: _ci, _cj = np.nonzero(probs > _CACHE_THRESHOLD)`; probabilities never exceed 1.0 -> nothing cached; no post-proc reader. Dead.

knobs.name: DIAGNOSTIC_ARM
knobs.what: Only names a pre-ILP coordinate-manifest jsonl (diagnostic). Dead for output.

knobs.name: DEEPCENTER_TTA
knobs.what: `if os.environ.get("BIOHUB_DEEPCENTER_TTA", "0") != "0":` flip-TTA averaging of the DeepCenter heatmap used by the gap veto and the safe-division veto (raises if TTA is a no-op). 0 = single view: shifts DC scores for both vetoes; saves some runtime.
knobs.tested_by_us: Inherited from sjlee dctta (P14 exp29 0.947); never varied alone.

knobs.name: OUTPUT_MOTION_RELINK
knobs.what: `if OUTPUT_MOTION_RELINK:` replace all ILP edges by the two-pass LAP motion relink (1:1). Off = keep ILP edges (incl. ILP forks). Also switched off by the deadline degrade.
knobs.tested_by_us: P21 exp40 relink OFF 0.945 vs exp29 0.947 (friend-B local +0.0053 did not transfer).

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_TIGHT_UM
knobs.what: With FLOW_MODE=seed and FLOW_SEED_GATE_UM=0 it is the SEED-pass gate that builds the flow field (`seed_gate_um = ... else MOTION_RELINK_TIGHT_UM`) and the tight gate only in frames without a flow field; the tight gate in flow frames is FLOW_TIGHT_UM 7.0.
knobs.tested_by_us: In P14 exp29 (validator picked tight55; 0.947). No single-knob LB probe on x138.
knobs.disclosed: Hammad 741242: the x138-family validator picks tight55 on every rerun; x138 PP_CANDIDATES has tight55.

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_RELAXED_UM
knobs.default: 10.0 (c2 default; FLOW_RELAXED_UM 0 falls back to it)
knobs.what: Second (relaxed) LAP pass gate for sources/targets left unmatched by the tight pass, in flow and non-flow frames alike (`flow_relaxed_um = ... else MOTION_RELINK_RELAXED_UM`).

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_LEARNED_BONUS
knobs.what: `cost[i, j] = motion + MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_RAW_COST * raw - MOTION_RELINK_LEARNED_BONUS * prob`; prob = the ILP edge's learned probability (0 for non-ILP pairs). The only channel by which ILP edges steer the final edges.

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_VELOCITY_WEIGHT
knobs.what: `predicted_arr[i] = source_pos + MOTION_RELINK_VELOCITY_WEIGHT * (source_pos - prev_pos)` - only for sources with no flow sample (flow field covers most sources in seed mode).

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_MAX_FRAME_NODES
knobs.what: `if frame_sizes and max(frame_sizes) > MOTION_RELINK_MAX_FRAME_NODES: return []` -> the whole clip keeps raw ILP edges. 0 skips in lab and in the exp70g public run_stats; a hidden-set safety valve.

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_MODE
knobs.what: Neighbourhood-flow prior: 'seed' = tight seed matches define a per-frame displacement field, then tight/relaxed passes run against the predicted positions; 'prev' = previous frame's field; 'off' = constant-velocity prior.

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_TIGHT_UM
knobs.what: Tight-pass gate in frames that have a flow field (`flow_tight_um = MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_TIGHT_UM if > 0 else MOTION_RELINK_TIGHT_UM`) - the de-facto main linking radius of x138.

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_RELAXED_UM
knobs.what: Relaxed-pass gate in flow frames; 0 falls back to MOTION_RELINK_RELAXED_UM.

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_K
knobs.what: Number of nearest seed matches averaged for a source's flow vector.

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_RADIUS_UM
knobs.what: `tree.query(source_pos, k=k_query, distance_upper_bound=MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_RADIUS_UM)`: neighbourhood radius for flow samples.

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_EXCLUDE_UM
knobs.what: Excludes a source's own seed match (within 1.5 um) from its flow sample so a wrong seed cannot vote for itself.

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_MIN_SAMPLES
knobs.what: `if len(flow_src) < MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_MIN_SAMPLES:` no field for the frame -> falls back to TIGHT_UM/velocity prior.

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_GATE
knobs.what: Also admits pairs whose target is within the gate of the flow-PREDICTED position (not only of the raw source position).

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_ITER
knobs.what: Refinement rounds re-deriving the field from the previous round's matches; >1 multiplies relink runtime.

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_SEED_GATE_UM
knobs.what: Seed-pass gate; 0 = use MOTION_RELINK_TIGHT_UM.

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_RAW_ADMIT
knobs.what: `raw_admits = MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_RAW_ADMIT or not (flow_gated and flow_hit[i])`: 1 keeps the raw-distance admission as well as the predicted one.

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_Z_WEIGHT
knobs.what: `flow_weight = [Z_WEIGHT, 1, 1]`: anisotropic motion distance (down-weights z error when < 1).

knobs.name: MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_RAW_COST
knobs.what: Adds RAW_COST * raw distance to the flow-predicted motion cost; 0 = pure predicted-position cost.

knobs.name: OUTPUT_EDGE_MAX_UM
knobs.what: `if OUTPUT_EDGE_MAX_UM > 0 and distance_um > OUTPUT_EDGE_MAX_UM:` drops long ILP edges before relink; relink replaces ILP edges anyway, so it only matters via the learned-prob lookup / relink fallback.

knobs.name: OUTPUT_ENFORCE_NEXT_FRAME / OUTPUT_SINGLE_PARENT_REPAIR / OUTPUT_SINGLE_CHILD_REPAIR
knobs.what: Validity repairs (t+1 edges only, one parent per node, optional one child). The 1:1 relink already satisfies them; structural, not levers.

knobs.name: READMIT_MIN_SCORE
knobs.cell: c0 l.94; c2 l.83; c7 l.1313; ALSO c4 `_LOWREFINE_MIN_SCORE = float(os.environ.get('BIOHUB_READMIT_MIN_SCORE', '0.965'))`
knobs.what: `keep = (d <= READMIT_RADIUS_UM) & (peaks["score"] >= READMIT_MIN_SCORE)`: discarded detector peaks near an open track end/start come back before the second relink. Coupled: the same value is the LOWREFINE threshold (0.94 -> +3.05% refined peaks on dummies).
knobs.tested_by_us: P50 exp85a (with ILP_DIVISION_WEIGHT 0.4) PENDING. exp85c (0.94 alone) dummy +0.84% nodes, 82 forks; exp86c 0.92 +1.21% nodes. Lab F-TRN-55: band [0.94,0.965) readmits +0.60% nodes, 0 within 4 um of GT (lab cannot sign it).
knobs.disclosed: John Taylor 743929: 0.965 -> 0.94 = +0.001 (0.958 -> 0.959), node change < 1%, 0 of 2,212 annotated edges changed locally. All other forks 0.965.

knobs.name: READMIT_RADIUS_UM
knobs.what: Max distance from an open end/start (t-1 end or t+1 start) for a readmitted peak; 0 disables readmit and the second relink. OUR CLOSED LIST (I-183).

knobs.name: OUTPUT_GAP_CLOSE
knobs.what: Master switch of single-frame gap closing (synthetic middle node, DeepCenter-confirmed). Off on deadline degrade.

knobs.name: GAP_CLOSE_MAX_GAP
knobs.what: `effective_gap_max = min(GAP_CLOSE_MAX_GAP, 1)` -> 2 behaves as 1; only 0 changes anything (disables). Dead as a lever above 1.

knobs.name: GAP_CLOSE_UM
knobs.cell: c0 l.18; c1 guard; c2 l.101; c7 l.864
knobs.what: `threshold_um = GAP_CLOSE_UM * (gap + 1)` = 10 um end-to-start span for a 1-frame gap (then density-adjusted).
knobs.tested_by_us: P08 exp24 6.5 -> 0.944 vs 0.945 (old exp06 base, noise).
knobs.disclosed: amanatar V6, anhadmahajan, indarkarhana: 5.8. x138 PP_CANDIDATES 'gap45' (4.5).

knobs.name: GAP_DENSITY_ADAPTIVE / GAP_DENSITY_REFERENCE_UM / GAP_DENSITY_GAIN / GAP_DENSITY_MAX_STEP_DELTA_UM / GAP_DENSITY_NEIGHBORS
knobs.what: Per-pair gap threshold shifted by clip(GAIN*(local NN spacing - 6.5), +-0.125) um per step: at most +-0.25 um on a 10 um gate -> tiny effect.

knobs.name: GAP_CLOSE_REUSE_EXISTING / GAP_CLOSE_REUSE_UM
knobs.what: Use an existing isolated node within 3.2 um of the interpolated midpoint instead of a synthetic one.

knobs.name: GAP_CLOSE_MAX_ADDED_FRAC / GAP_CLOSE_MAX_ADDED_ABS
knobs.what: Budget of synthetic gap nodes per clip: min(2000, 5% of nodes).

knobs.name: GAP_REFINE_SYNTHETIC / GAP_REFINE_WIN_Z / GAP_REFINE_WIN_YX / GAP_REFINE_MAX_SHIFT_UM
knobs.what: Snap a synthetic middle node to the local image maximum in a (±1, ±3, ±3) voxel window if the shift is <= 3.2 um.

knobs.name: DEEPCENTER_GAP_VETO / DEEPCENTER_GAP_THRESHOLD / DEEPCENTER_GAP_CONFIRM_MIN_SPAN_UM
knobs.what: A synthetic middle node on a gap spanning >= 8.5 um must have DeepCenter score >= 0.25 (`requires_center_confirmation = DEEPCENTER_GAP_VETO and marginal_gap and synthetic_middle`), else the gap edge and node are dropped.
knobs.tested_by_us: None on LB (F-MOD-26 lists DEEPCENTER_GAP_THRESHOLD as a valid --set knob, never probed).

knobs.name: OUTPUT_GAP2_RECOVERY
knobs.what: Strict 2-frame gap recovery (end at t -> start at t+3 with two interpolated nodes) with direction-context check and caps.

knobs.name: GAP2_MAX_TOTAL_UM
knobs.what: `if dist > GAP2_MAX_TOTAL_UM or dist / 3.0 > GAP2_MAX_STEP_UM: continue` - total end-to-start span gate (the binding one).

knobs.name: GAP2_MAX_STEP_UM
knobs.what: Per-step gate, but with TOTAL 10.2 every admitted pair has step <= 3.4 um, so any value >= 3.4 is inert (x138's 'gap2step40' candidate 4.0 changes nothing).

knobs.name: GAP2_MAX_LINKS_FRAC / GAP2_MAX_LINKS_ABS / GAP2_REQUIRE_CONTEXT / GAP2_FRAME_FRAC_CAP
knobs.what: gap2 budget min(180, 0.45% of edges), per-frame cap 0.6% of ends, and the direction-continuity requirement.

knobs.name: GAPFILL_MAX_GAP
knobs.what: Max gap length the low-detection filler bridges with real sub-threshold peaks. ALSO gates readmit: `if GAPFILL_MAX_GAP < 1 or not cache_dir: return None` in load_low_detections -> 0 disables readmit too.

knobs.name: GAPFILL_MIN_SCORE
knobs.what: `keep = score >= GAPFILL_MIN_SCORE` on the lowdet pool used by BOTH the gap filler and readmit (readmit then needs >= READMIT_MIN_SCORE anyway, so it binds on the filler only).

knobs.name: GAPFILL_STEP_UM / GAPFILL_PEAK_RADIUS_UM / GAPFILL_ALLOW_SYNTHETIC / GAPFILL_CONTEXT
knobs.what: Bridge gate `gate = GAPFILL_STEP_UM * (g + 1)`; each interpolated frame needs a free peak within 3.5 um (0 synthetic allowed); direction-context check.

knobs.name: GAPFILL_EXCLUDE_UM
knobs.what: `free = d > GAPFILL_EXCLUDE_UM`: peaks within 2 um of an existing node are removed from the pool (also for readmit).

knobs.name: GAPFILL_MAX_ADDED_FRAC
knobs.what: `budget = int(round(len(nodes_by_id) * GAPFILL_MAX_ADDED_FRAC))`; lab: budget not binding.

knobs.name: OUTPUT_SAFE_DIVISIONS
knobs.what: Master switch of the post-link geometric division repair (the only source of forks besides DIVINS).

knobs.name: SAFE_DIV_MAX_UM
knobs.what: `if parent_dist > SAFE_DIV_MAX_UM: continue` - parent to orphan-candidate distance for a new second daughter.
knobs.tested_by_us: Lab R13DP-1: parent 8.0/10.0 not >= 0 on both embryos.
knobs.disclosed: amanatar V6 10.5 (bundle; V6 public 0.901); indarkarhana v1 4.66.

knobs.name: SAFE_DIV_SISTER_MAX_UM
knobs.what: `if sister_dist > SAFE_DIV_SISTER_MAX_UM: continue` (existing child to candidate).
knobs.disclosed: amanatar V6 15.0; sjlee 'sister16' fork 16 -> 0.947 (tie, 0.947 stack); indarkarhana 8.5.

knobs.name: SAFE_DIV_SISTER_SYMMETRY_TAU
knobs.what: `if abs(child_dist - parent_dist) / _sym_denom > SAFE_DIV_SISTER_SYMMETRY_TAU:` reject asymmetric daughter pairs.
knobs.tested_by_us: Lab: embryo-specific (6bba +0.005, 44b6 -0.001..-0.002); tau 0.75 rung I-395 refuted/never submitted.

knobs.name: SAFE_DIV_DIVERGE_UM
knobs.what: `if grandchild_dist - sister_dist < SAFE_DIV_DIVERGE_UM:` daughters must separate by >= 2.25 um from t+1 to t+2.
knobs.tested_by_us: Lab: 2.5-2.75 >= 0 on both embryos (I-333), never submitted.

knobs.name: SAFE_DIV_EXISTING_CHILD_MAX_UM
knobs.what: Parent-to-existing-child distance gate.

knobs.name: SAFE_DIV_FRAME_FRAC_CAP / SAFE_DIV_GLOBAL_FRAC_CAP
knobs.what: Caps: per frame max(1, round(0.76% of one-child sources)); per clip max(1, round(0.375% of edges)).
knobs.tested_by_us: Lab: GLOBAL 0.0025/0.005 exactly 0 (caps never bind); frame cap 6bba-only.

knobs.name: SAFE_DIV_REQUIRE_DIVERGENCE / SAFE_DIV_REQUIRE_MUTUAL_NN
knobs.what: Candidate must be the existing child's nearest orphan (mutual NN) and pass the t+2 divergence test.

knobs.name: DEEPCENTER_SAFE_DIV_VETO / DEEPCENTER_SAFE_DIV_THRESHOLD
knobs.what: New daughter must have DeepCenter score >= 0.25 (`deepcenter_accept_repair_point(..., DEEPCENTER_SAFE_DIV_THRESHOLD)`). OUR CLOSED LIST (DC).
knobs.disclosed: lineage-forge + mtoshidesu/sjlee dctta020: 0.20; sjlee forks 0.25 0.947 tie, 0.15 0.946 (0.947 stack).

knobs.name: USE_DEEPCENTER_VETO / REQUIRE_DEEPCENTER_VETO / DEEPCENTER_EXPECTED_EPOCH / DEEPCENTER_CHECKPOINT / DEEPCENTER_SCORE_WIN_Z / _YX / _CACHE_MAX_FRAMES
knobs.cell: c0 l.49-53; c2 l.153-172; c3 l.561 (checkpoint re-set to the materialized path); c7 l.371-519
knobs.what: DeepCenter model loading/sanity (epoch check, required) and the scoring window (max over ±1 z, ±2 yx voxels). Infra/sanity; WIN_* would change both vetoes' scores but nobody tunes them.

knobs.name: OUTPUT_DIVISION_GEOMETRY_FILTER / DIV_PARENT_MAX_UM / DIV_SISTER_MAX_UM / DIV_DROP_TO_SINGLE_IF_BAD
knobs.what: Optional post-hoc fork geometry filter; OFF, so the three parameters are dead unless the switch is set.

knobs.name: DIVINS_ENABLE / DIVINS_STEAL
knobs.what: Post-tail DaughterNet insertion of (u, c1, v) forks; steal = may take v from a weak parent w (edge_prob < 0.3, margin 0.2, at most floor(0.5*cap) steals).
knobs.tested_by_us: P35 0.954, P37 K2 0.954 vs P38 no-insertion 0.953.

knobs.name: DIVINS_CAP / DIVINS_FRAME_CAP
knobs.what: Max insertions per video / per parent frame. OUR CLOSED LIST (cap/frame-cap).

knobs.name: DIVINS_THRESH
knobs.what: `score = p_par(u) * p_dau(v) * p_dau(c1) ** alpha; only score >= threshold is eligible`. OUR CLOSED LIST.

knobs.name: DIVINS_ALPHA
knobs.what: Exponent on the first daughter's p_dau in the insertion score; lower alpha = more eligible triples (score rises), like a lower threshold.

knobs.name: DIVINS_DEADLINE_S
knobs.what: `if _deadline_degraded or elapsed >= SAFETAIL_DIVINS_DEADLINE_S:` skip insertion for remaining clips (8 h). Safety.
knobs.tested_by_us: All safetail probes (no skip fired on LB, L <= 7.8 h).

knobs.name: DIVINS_DUMP / DIVINS_DUMP_DIR / DIVINS_BATCH / DIVINS_WEIGHTS / DIVINS_FORCE_FAIL
knobs.what: Parity dump, scoring batch, weight glob, dummy-test fail switch. No output effect in normal runs.

knobs.name: OUTPUT_PRUNE_ISOLATED
knobs.what: Drops nodes with no incident edge after safe divisions (readmitted nodes the relink left unattached die here).

knobs.name: OUTPUT_FILTER_SHORT_TRACKS / OUTPUT_KEEP_DIVISION_COMPONENTS
knobs.what: Component-length filter on/off; components with a fork are always kept.

knobs.name: OUTPUT_MIN_TRACK_LEN
knobs.what: `if len(members) >= OUTPUT_MIN_TRACK_LEN or (OUTPUT_KEEP_DIVISION_COMPONENTS and has_division):` keep component. Moves node count directly (2.19% of lab nodes removed at 6).
knobs.tested_by_us: P06 4 -> 0.943, P09 8 -> 0.944 vs 0.945 (old exp06 base): both directions lose -> closed at 6. R13NC-4: 7/9 not profitable (lab).

HARD-SET after cell 0 (--set is a silent no-op): cell 3 SECONDARY_EDGE_WEIGHT 0.15, SECONDARY_DETECTION_WEIGHT 0.80, SECONDARY_LINK_MODE, SECONDARY_MIX_TEMPERATURE 1, SECONDARY_LOW_MARGIN_MAX 0.35, DUAL_SEED_EDGE_THRESHOLD 0.48, SECONDARY_WEIGHTS, DEEPCENTER_CHECKPOINT; cell 4 DUAL_SEED_MIN_CANDIDATE_RETENTION 0.90, EDGE_FEATURE_TTA 1, SECONDARY_EDGE_FEATURE_TTA 1 / _WEIGHT 0.75 (plus V1284_MODE/V1284_HEAD, non-BIOHUB). LOCKED: BIDIRECTIONAL_EDGE_WEIGHT has a second guard in cell 4 (ValueError unless 0.15) that the builder does not patch -> --set errors the kernel. DEAD/INERT: CACHE_EDGE_THRESHOLD 1.0 (probs > 1.0 never), GAP_CLOSE_MAX_GAP (min(.,1)), GAP2_MAX_STEP_UM >= 3.4 (TOTAL 10.2 binds), LOWDET_THRESHOLD in [0,0.5] (pool filtered at GAPFILL_MIN_SCORE 0.5), short-track rescue params (trigger >= 10% never met), division geometry filter params (switch off), validator/PPSWEEP (VALIDATOR_ENABLE 0), RUN_OUTPUT_DIAGNOSTICS, DIAGNOSTIC_ARM, FUSION_MODE. COUPLINGS: READMIT_MIN_SCORE is also the LOWREFINE threshold (c4 `_LOWREFINE_MIN_SCORE`); readmit reads its pool through load_low_detections, so GAPFILL_MAX_GAP=0, GAPFILL_EXCLUDE_UM and CACHE_DIR also move/disable readmit.
